results.source_supported_mechanism: AQuA runs outside the agent request path in the Google Cloud project, samples recent traces, reviews against a checklist, clusters similar failures, verifies clusters with complete transcripts, and can diagnose against a deployment-bound source snapshot. caveats: Do not imply that AQuA intercepts live production requests or automatically applies fixes.

This is a real reusable skills mechanism rather than an unsupported generic agent mention.
results.source_supported_mechanism: Business and organizational context plus a selected reusable skill feed an agent, governed connectors and reports; the reporting skill uses catalog-grounded schema to form a saved query that can be rerun without an additional model call.
caveats: Keep vendor-announced capabilities distinct from independent efficacy tests.
Differentiate tools registry from skills registry; generated dashboards are not proof of governed approval flows.
